answer: Cross-Cluster Correlation Audit. Group agent identities by shared counterparties, then measure how many distinct clusters recycle the same signing keys or deposit addresses. A genuine operator leaves a marble of reuse across clusters; sybils leave timber-thick overlap trails. When overlap exceeds a fixed threshold, all linked identities are suspended on a shared ledge pending review. An attacker must fund each false identity from clean, non-reused infrastructure, raising cost per identity to full independent operation rather than marginal copying.
